note: As an aspect/modal particle 了 is read le (neutral); liǎo is the verb "to finish/understand"
关系 in 没关系 is neutral: méi guānxi (HSK list and 现代汉语词典)
Official HSK 1 entry is 没 méi (adv.), normally taught as 没/没有; keeping 没有 is acceptable
名字 has neutral second syllable: míngzi
Erhua is one syllable nǎr, not two syllables with a second-tone ér; this is a real error not a spacing choice
朋友 has neutral second syllable: péngyou
Dictionaries give qiánmian with neutral 面 but HSK list and Standard Course use qiánmiàn; both acceptable
shuí is a valid reading but shéi is the more common colloquial form and is what the HSK list uses; consider shéi
时候 has neutral second syllable: shíhou

id: - Missing: 那儿 (nàr, there). The official list pairs 那（那儿）just as it pairs 哪（哪儿）; since this batch gives 哪儿 its own entry (w069), 那儿 should be added for consistency, or 哪儿 folded into 哪.
- 没 vs 没有: the official HSK 1 entry is 没 méi (not). The draft has 没有 (w064) instead. That is acceptable as the usual taught form, but if you want an exact match to the list, the headword is 没.
- Not HSK 1: none. Every entry in this batch is on the HSK 1 (2.0) list.
